text: Which field state is the eigenstate of the annihilation operator a and has Poissonian photon-number statistics (Mandel Q = 0, shot noise)?
explanation: The coherent state |alpha> satisfies a|alpha> = alpha|alpha> and has Poisson number statistics (Q = 0), the quantum model of ideal laser light. A Fock state has delta-n = 0 (Q = -1, sub-Poissonian); squeezed vacuum contains only even photon pairs; thermal light is super-Poissonian (Q > 0).
